title: UniDoc-RL: Coarse-to-Fine Visual RAG with Hierarchical Actions and Dense Rewards
authors: Jun Wang; Shuo Tan; Zelong Sun; Tiancheng Gu; Yongle Zhao; Ziyong Feng; Kaicheng Yang; Zhiwu Lu
why_relevant: Proposes an RL-based visual RAG framework that filters irrelevant retrieved images and focuses on informative regions, tangentially addressing noisy retrieval in multimodal RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on improving visual RAG performance via hierarchical actions and dense rewards, not on robustness, calibration, conflict, or adversarial reliability per se.
